# Vamp

> Install Vamp Sync on the Mac you want to reach. Connect with Vamp Control
> from another Mac, iPhone, or iPad over a trusted LAN or private Tailscale network.

- Website: https://thevamp.app/
- Downloads: https://thevamp.app/#download
- Vamp Sync: https://thevamp.app/sync/
- Vamp Control: https://thevamp.app/#control
- Source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite

Vamp Sync is the macOS menu-bar host. Share a selected app window with a
verified Vamp Control device over authenticated WebRTC. Screen Recording
enables video. Keyboard and pointer control require the website edition of
Sync and the user’s Accessibility approval. The Mac App Store edition of Sync
shares existing app windows in view-only mode.

Verify every new device’s complete fingerprint independently before approving
it on the Mac. Keep host ports private. Vamp requires no hosted relay.

- Install: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md
- iOS sideloading: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite/blob/main/docs/IOS_SIDELOAD.md
- Security: https://github.com/Mesutcydev/vamp-suite/blob/main/SECURITY.md
